nodes.label: Wayrest Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 CSS-first approach preferred via @theme blocks; JS config retained for tooling compatibility (IDE plugins, legacy integrations). Tokens map 1:1 to DESIGN.md. Color palette uses Ember (primary), Pine (secondary), Parchment (neutral) — outdoor/journey aesthetic. Warm-tinted shadows use rgba(64,57,46,...) base.

nodes.label: Supabase Server-Only Config Gap
nodes.rationale: SPEC-GAP: server routes cannot import from app/composables, so Supabase is initialized directly in each server route. supabaseUrl/supabaseKey are server-only runtimeConfig — this works for SSR but not pure client-side. Future spec should move keys to runtimeConfig.public if direct client-side Supabase access is needed.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development Methodology
nodes.rationale: Every feature is defined by a spec before being implemented by an AI coding agent. The spec is submitted, the agent asks questions before coding, delivered code is validated against the spec, and the spec is committed alongside the code as documentation. This ensures requirements are explicit and verifiable, preventing AI agents from making undocumented architecture decisions.

nodes.label: Ember Primary Color System
nodes.rationale: Ember (#C25A33) chosen as primary color to evoke lantern glow — a waypoint marker aesthetic. Used for CTAs, brand marks, selected states, and price emphasis. Color ramps designed for OKLCH-adjacent perceptual uniformity.

nodes.label: Pine Secondary Color System
nodes.rationale: Pine (#335E42) chosen as secondary color to evoke the trail at dusk. Used for trust signals (Superhost, verified), tertiary CTAs, success-adjacent states. Warm-grounded aesthetic pairing with Ember.
